package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for many_column_or_filter_chain: Query chains with many OR filter conditions that often scale poorly.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type Document struct {
	ID     int
	Status string
	Owner  string
	Type   string
	Region string
	Tag    string
}

func FindDocuments(db *gorm.DB, filters map[string]string) ([]Document, error) {
	var docs []Document
	q := db.Model(&Document{})
	for k, v := range filters {
		q = q.Or(k+" = ?", v)
	}
	err := q.Find(&docs).Error
	return docs, err
}
